AND A.CSHR_STTS_CD != 'SL' AND A.PSG_CGO_SE_CD = 'Y' AND A.ARCFT_USE_SE_CD IN ('0', '1') AND A.GD_FLT_PRPS_CD IN ('00', '05') AND A.FRY_YN NOT IN ('Y') AND A.DOM_INTL_SE_CD NOT IN ('D') AND A.DLY_RSN_CD NOT IN ('2', '3')

NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN A.ARR_DEP_SE_CD = 'D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS DEP_FLT_CNT, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN A.ARR_DEP_SE_CD = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS ARR_FLT_CNT, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN A.ARR_DEP_SE_CD = 'D' THEN A.RSVT_BDPSG_CNT - A.RSVT_TRNS_BDPSG_CNT ELSE 0 END), 0) AS DEP_PSG_CNT, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN A.ARR_DEP_SE_CD = 'A' THEN A.RSVT_BDPSG_CNT - A.RSVT_TRNS_BDPSG_CNT ELSE 0 END), 0) AS ARR_PSG_CNT
mapper.select:
/* CastDsbdMapper.retrieveFltSmry */ SELECT FROM GOOWN.TN_GO_GD_DATA A WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.GD_SE_YMD = #{ymd}
-- T1 은 제1여객터미널(P01) + 탑승동(P02), T2 는 제2여객터미널(P03) AND A.TMNL_ID IN (#{item})

/* CastDsbdMapper.retrieveRsltByHourList */ -- 결과 상세는 10분 간격이다. 화면 축이 1시간이라 시 단위로 접는다. -- 대기인원은 순간값이라 합이 아니라 MAX, 시간 지표는 평균이다 SELECT TO_CHAR(A.SMLT_ACTL_DT, 'HH24') || '00' AS TIME, NVL(MAX(A.WTNG_PSG_CNT), 0) AS WTNG_PSG_CNT, NVL(SUM(A.TRNST_PSG_CNT), 0) AS TRNST_PSG_CNT, NVL(ROUND(AVG(A.AVG_WTNG_HR)), 0) AS WTNG_HR, NVL(ROUND(AVG(A.AVG_PRCS_HR)), 0) AS PRCS_HR FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_RSLT_DTL A INNER JOIN PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_PSG_FCLT B ON A.PSG_FCLT_CD = B.PSG_FCLT_CD WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.SMLT_ID = #{smltId} AND B.TMNL_ID = #{tmnlId} AND B.USE_YN = 'Y' -- LS 랜드사이드 좌석, CC 체크인카운터, CK 셀프체크인, SBD 셀프백드랍, LGT 출국장, LC 출국심사, SC 보안검색대, SR 보안검색대RED AND B.UP_PSG_FCLT_CD IN (#{item}) GROUP BY TO_CHAR(A.SMLT_ACTL_DT, 'HH24') ORDER BY TIME
mapper.sql: TO_CHAR(A.SMLT_ACTL_DT, 'HH24MI') AS TIME, A.SMLT_ACTL_DT, B.UP_PSG_FCLT_CD, AS UNIT_CD, NVL(SUM(A.WTNG_PSG_CNT), 0) AS WTNG_PSG_CNT, NVL(SUM(A.TRNST_PSG_CNT), 0) AS TRNST_PSG_CNT, NVL(ROUND(MAX(A.AVG_WTNG_HR)), 0) AS WTNG_HR, NVL(ROUND(MAX(A.AVG_PRCS_HR)), 0) AS PRCS_HR
mapper.select: /* CastDsbdMapper.retrievePsgPrcsGradeList */ SELECT A.FCLT_GROUP_CD, A.PSG_PRCS_GRD_CD, A.MIN_VL, A.MAX_VL FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_PSG_PRCS_GRD A WHERE A.FCLT_GROUP_CD = #{fcltGroupCd} ORDER BY A.PSG_PRCS_GRD_CD

/* CastDsbdMapper.retrieveScrtyOpenCountList */ SELECT A.GATE_NO AS UNIT_CD, COUNT(*) AS TOT_CNT, MAX(A.FCLTY_CNT) AS OPR_CNT FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_FCLTY_OPNG_SCRTY_CNTRL_ATRB A WHERE A.SCRTY_CNTRL_ATRB_ID = REGEXP_REPLACE( #{scrtyCntrlRsrcId}, 'FOTSC|FacilityOpeningTable_SecurityControl', '' ) AND A.TMNL_ID = #{tmnlId} GROUP BY A.GATE_NO ORDER BY UNIT_CD

/* CastDsbdMapper.retrieveFcltUnitList */ -- 미운영 시설도 카드의 "전체" 에는 들어가야 하므로 USE_YN 으로 거르지 않고 나눠 센다 SELECT AS UNIT_CD, COUNT(*) AS TOT_CNT, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN B.USE_YN = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS OPR_CNT FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_PSG_FCLT B WHERE 1 = 1 AND B.TMNL_ID = #{tmnlId} AND B.UP_PSG_FCLT_CD IN (#{item}) GROUP BY ORDER BY UNIT_CD

/* CastDsbdMapper.retrieveWeather */ -- 기상정보는 하루 최대 2회(07/09시) 발표된다. 가장 최근 발표를 그날의 대표값으로 쓴다. -- 집계라 대상 일자에 발표가 없어도 NULL 채운 행 1개가 온다 (NVL 로 기본값 처리) SELECT NVL(MAX(A.WTHR_CN) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY A.CRT_HM DESC), '') AS WTHR_CN, TO_NUMBER(NVL(MAX(A.MAX_TP) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY A.CRT_HM DESC), '0')) AS MAX_TP, TO_NUMBER(NVL(MAX(A.MIN_TP) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY A.CRT_HM DESC), '0')) AS MIN_TP, TO_NUMBER(NVL(MAX(A.HMDT_VL) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY A.CRT_HM DESC), '0')) AS HMDT_VL, TO_NUMBER(NVL(MAX(A.WS_VL) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY A.CRT_HM DESC), '0')) AS WS_VL, TO_NUMBER(NVL(MAX(A.RWY_ATM) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY A.CRT_HM DESC), '0')) AS RWY_ATM FROM GOOWN.TN_GO_WTHCN_INFO A WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.CRT_YMD = #{ymd} AND A.CTY_NM = '인천'
